headline: MOGUL v11.5 — from empire to galactic federation (steps 1-2)
summary: V11-9 phase 1: five entity tiers climbed strictly one at a time — conglomerate → autonomous territory → independent nation → interstellar empire → galactic federation. Tiers 4-5 (empire, federation) are stubbed; v11.7 will wire star-system control + galactic geography. v11.5 lands the first three tiers fully. Declare autonomy from your origin nation once you hit $50M + 50 influence. Court foreign recognition (30 influence per nation, need 3). Declare independence with $500M + 200 influence + recognition 3/3 — pick one of 4 constitutions (corporatist/democratic/authoritarian/technocratic) with different bizMult / taxRate / militaryUpkeep / closureRisk, and a 3-letter currency code (with 2% baseline inflation that compounds yearly).
features: Five entity tiers: conglomerate ($1M, auto) / autonomous ($50M + 50 infl, action) / nation ($500M + 200 infl + 3 recognition, action) / empire ($5B + 500 infl + 5 systems — v11.7 stub) / federation ($50B + 2000 infl + 50% space — v11.7 stub)
No skipping — must climb strictly one tier at a time
Auto-promote to conglomerate when net worth crosses $1M (yearly tick)
Declare autonomy: requires conglomerate tier + $50M + 50 influence; sets originNation
Court recognition: 30 influence per nation, cap 12; needed for independence
Declare independence: requires autonomous tier + $500M + 200 influence + recognition ≥3

4 constitutions: corporatist (biz×1.20, tax 15%, closure +2%), democratic (baseline, tax 25%, upkeep ×1.2), authoritarian (biz×0.90, tax 35%, upkeep ×0.7, closure +5%), technocratic (biz×1.10, tax 20%, upkeep ×0.9, closure +1%)
Custom 3-letter currency code; 2% baseline inflation erodes cash yearly at nation+ tier
bizMultiplier now stacks the constitution's bizMult on top of everything else
New 'Empire' tab in the World group showing tier ladder + constitution picker + currency input + action buttons
v11.7 stub note for empire + federation tiers (gated by star-system control)
Version bumped to v11.5 on homepage + version.json
